system.description: At the beginning of each session, roll a number of d12s equal to your subclass's Power trait and place them on your character sheet in the space provided. These are your Loaded Dice. You can spend a Loaded Die when making an action roll, to switch a die's value with the value of one of your Duality Dice. At the end of each session, clear all unspent Loaded Dice.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v2.0 Mind

system.gmNotes: With a Power trait of 0 or less there are no Loaded Dice; the playtest does not address it.
